plugin.note: Waterfiends are usually handled with crush melee and high Magic Defence. Earth magic is faster but more expensive; Ranged can be used when wearing Ranged armour for Magic Defence. Ancient Cavern supports safespotting, Kraken Cove is task-only, and Iorwerth Dungeon supports cannoning and crystal shard drops.

requirements: Access to the Ancient Cavern through Barbarian Firemaking training
Song of the Elves for Iorwerth Dungeon
Fairy ring AKQ for quick Kraken Cove access
High Level Alchemy runes recommended for armour and staff drops
mechanics: Waterfiends attack with Magic and magical Ranged.
Protection prayers cannot negate all damage because Waterfiends use two attack styles.
Both attacks roll against the player's Magic Defence.
Protect from Missiles is the most useful protection prayer if incoming damage is too high.
Dragonhide, Karil's armour, Eclipse Moon armour, and a saturated or imbued heart improve effective defence.
Waterfiends have low crush Defence and are usually killed with crush melee weapons.
Waterfiends have a 100% elemental weakness to Earth spells.
Non-earth Magic is discouraged because Waterfiends have high Magic level and magic Defence.
Waterfiends are demons, so demonbane weapons apply.
Ancient Cavern is safespottable, Kraken Cove is task-only, and Iorwerth Dungeon is cannonable.

methods.label: Requirements and access
methods.summary: Confirm 75 combat and Ancient Cavern access before accepting or routing a Waterfiends task.
requiredOrKeyItems: Fairy ring AKQ for Kraken Cove
steps: Confirm the account has 75 combat unless combat requirements are being ignored by Slayer masters.
Confirm Ancient Cavern access through Barbarian Firemaking training.
Use a games necklace to Barbarian Assault for Ancient Cavern routing.
Use fairy ring AKQ for Kraken Cove if the task location is Kraken Cove.
Use a teleport crystal only if Song of the Elves is complete and the task will be done in Iorwerth Dungeon.
Bring High Level Alchemy runes because Waterfiends commonly drop armour and staves.

methods.label: Crush melee with Magic Defence
methods.summary: Use crush melee weapons with high Magic Defence armour for the default low-cost Waterfiends method.
recommendedFor: Ancient Cavern or Kraken Cove tasks
prayers: Protect from Missiles if damage is too high
steps: Wear Slayer helmet or black mask on task and choose armour with strong Magic Defence.
Prioritise crush weapons because Waterfiends have only 10 crush Defence compared with high stab and slash Defence.
Use Eclipse Moon armour when available because it keeps Magic Defence while providing Strength bonus.
Use a saturated or imbued heart if available to increase Magic Defence.
Turn on Protect from Missiles when incoming damage is too high, accepting that Magic attacks still hit.
Use High Level Alchemy on armour and staff drops to extend the trip.
risks: Protection prayers do not fully shut off incoming damage.
Waterfiends are accurate enough that low Magic Defence armour increases food usage.

methods.label: Earth magic
methods.summary: Exploit the 100% earth elemental weakness for faster kills when the rune cost is acceptable.
steps: Use earth spells or an earth-focused magic setup to exploit the 100% elemental weakness.
Prefer earth magic over non-earth magic because non-earth spells perform poorly into their high Magic level and Defence.
Use the Ancient Cavern river safespot when possible to avoid taking damage while casting.
If tanking, keep enough Magic Defence and food because Waterfiends still attack accurately.
Swap to an expeditious bracelet near kill credit if using that task-speed tactic.
risks: The task page notes earth magic is generally faster than melee but costs more.

methods.label: Ranged defence option
methods.summary: Use Ranged when wearing Ranged armour for Magic Defence, especially if safespotting or avoiding melee gear swaps.
recommendedFor: Players already wearing Dragonhide or Karil's armour
Accounts with stronger Ranged than melee
steps: Wear Ranged armour that contributes Magic Defence against both Waterfiend attacks.
Use Ranged from a safespot in Ancient Cavern where possible.
If not safespotting, use Protect from Missiles when the ranged-style attack is causing too much damage.
Use High Level Alchemy runes for longer trips.
notes: The task page allows Ranged when Ranged armour is being used defensively.

methods.label: Ancient Cavern safespot
methods.summary: Use Ancient Cavern for the only task-page safespot, including the 10 min aggression timer route if needed.
requiredOrKeyItems: Food for the run to the safespot
steps: Travel to Barbarian Assault with a games necklace and enter the Ancient Cavern.
Use Ranged or Magic across the river because Waterfiends only attack 4 horizontal tiles.
Alternatively wait out aggression by running to the pillar safespot, back to the whirlpool landing platform, and then back to the safespot.
After the aggression timer is inactive, use the north-west stalagmite across the river as described by the task page.
risks: The run into Ancient Cavern can be dangerous if tank gear and food are inadequate.

methods.label: Kraken Cove task-only
methods.summary: Use Kraken Cove for a simple task-only Waterfiend area reached quickly with fairy ring AKQ.
steps: Use fairy ring AKQ to reach Kraken Cove quickly.
Fight the 15 Waterfiends in the task-only section.
Use the same crush melee and Magic Defence setup as the default method.
Do not plan around cannoning or safespotting because the task page marks both unavailable here.

methods.label: Iorwerth Dungeon cannon
methods.summary: Use Iorwerth Dungeon after Song of the Elves for cannon support and crystal shards.
recommendedFor: Players with Song of the Elves complete
steps: Travel with a teleport crystal after completing Song of the Elves.
Set up a dwarf multicannon because the task page marks Iorwerth Dungeon Waterfiends as cannonable.
Kill the 20 Waterfiends with crush melee or earth magic while the cannon adds damage.
Account for crystal shard drops when comparing profit to Ancient Cavern or Kraken Cove.
risks: This location is not safespottable according to the task-page comparison row.
Cannonballs can make a low-value task less profitable.
notes: Waterfiends in Iorwerth Dungeon can drop crystal shards, slightly increasing profit.

methods.label: Skip guidance
methods.summary: Consider skipping Waterfiends because the task page notes accurate attacks, mediocre drops, and assignment weight 2.
steps: Compare the expected supply cost and time against better Slayer tasks.
Skip if the account is not targeting Mist battlestaff, crystal shards, or specific collection goals.
Avoid blocking Waterfiends in most cases because their assignment weight is only 2.
notes: The task page explicitly says Waterfiends are often advisable to skip and not advisable to block.

styleOptions.label: Crush melee
styleOptions.summary: Primary Waterfiends setup: crush weapon, Slayer helmet, Magic Defence armour, and Protect from Missiles when needed.

styleOptions.label: Earth magic
styleOptions.summary: Use earth spells or Eye of ayak/Twinflame staff style routing to exploit the 100% earth weakness at higher supply cost.

styleOptions.label: Ranged defence
styleOptions.summary: Use Ranged when Dragonhide, Karil's, or Eclipse Moon armour is already being worn for Magic Defence.
